item.title: Nifty premium slips as traders brace for renewed West Asia tensions
item.description: A lower cost implies that traders prefer to go light into the 3 November event despite the market being oversold.

item.title: Top 3 stocks to buy tomorrow: Kotak Mahindra Bank, Nykaa, Eternal by market expert; check stop-loss, target price
item.description: Indian markets rebounded after seven losing sessions, with the Nifty 50 gaining 1.1% and Sensex rising 1.2%, supported by upbeat earnings and the US Federal holding rates steady. Analyst Chandan Taparia recommended Kotak Mahindra Bank, Nykaa and Eternal, with specified targets and stop-loss levels.

item.title: Yes Bank shares extend decline to 26% in October, hit a multi-year low. Why are investors turning cautious?
item.description: Yes Bank shares fell 1.15% to ₹15.43 on October 29, their lowest since April 2023, extending October losses to 29%. The decline followed the Supreme Court’s decision to uphold the reversal of the bank’s ₹8,415 crore AT-1 bond write-off, raising concerns over capital and unpaid coupons.

item.title: Karwa Chauth today but gold, silver rates not glittering — will prices rebound or pain will continue till Diwali?

item.title: TCS, Infosys, HCL Tech: Anthropic revenue soars 14-fold in H1 2026 - Can Indian IT stocks benefit from AI boom?
item.description: Anand Rathi says Indian IT firms could benefit from enterprise AI adoption by integrating AI into business systems, offering a less capital-intensive opportunity than building computing infrastructure.&nbsp;

item.title: Reliance Power shares on fire! Anil Ambani’s stock jumps 9.22%, but remains down 59% in a year - should you buy?
item.description: Reliance Power shares rose 9.22% on Thursday, extending a weekly gain to 11.21%, but remain 59% below their year-ago level. Analysts say the rebound may be temporary: resistance sits near ₹20–22, while ₹16 is key support. They advise caution until a decisive breakout confirms a trend reversal.

item.title: IPO, FPO and SME listing rules: SEBI to review framework, says Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey
item.description: SEBI is reviewing IPO, FPO and SME listing rules, seeking clearer disclosures, stronger oversight of IPO proceeds and lower-cost, more efficient SME listings. Chair Tuhin Kanta Pandey also wants to prepare more businesses for listing and remove inactive firms that may pose shell-company risks.

item.title: MSCI Rejig: LIC, Meesho likely to enter India Standard Index; OFSS, Siemens Energy may be dropped
item.description: JM Financial expects the November 2026 MSCI India Standard Index review could add LIC and Meesho and exclude Oracle Financial Services Software and Siemens Energy India. The changes may generate estimated net passive inflows of about $1.4 billion; final decisions await MSCI’s announcement.

item.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank shares gain over 4%, hit highest level since April 2025; here’s what you should know
item.description: Kotak Mahindra Bank shares rose 4.3% to ₹459, their highest level since April 2025. On Saturday, the bank reported a 26% jump in consolidated net profit for the September quarter at ₹5,645 crore.

item.title: Working with RBI to make process of bringing foreign investors into Indian markets faster and easier: SEBI chief
item.description: SEBI will review compliance requirements for foreign portfolio investors and issue a consultation paper on aligning Indian rules with global standards while preserving investor safeguards.

item.title: Diwali stocks 2026: Tata Steel, MCX, IHCL and 8 more to add sparkle to shares portfolio in Samvat 2083 | Full list
item.description: SBI Securities expects a gradual recovery in Indian equities in Samvat 2083 and names 11 stocks as potential opportunities. Its picks span metals, hotels, finance, engineering, power, electronics and automotive components.&nbsp;

item.title: Zensar Technologies shares on a roll! IT stock jumps 8%, up 25% in month - What's fuelling the rally?
item.description: Zensar Technologies shares rose nearly 8.17% on Thursday after the IT company reported Q2FY27 results, extending their monthly rally to about 25%. Revenue grew across geographies, while EBITDA margin reached 15.8%, up 120 basis points sequentially.

item.title: US Fed FOMC pauses interest rates: Can Nifty bulls take charge or will RBI hike spoil the rally? Investors guide
item.description: The Fed’s decision to hold rates offered temporary support to Indian equities, but Emkay expects the RBI to raise rates by 75 basis points by February 2027. Elevated oil prices, inflation and tighter domestic policy could limit gains, leaving the Nifty’s outlook uncertain.

item.title: HUL’s revenue growth has a party pooper, and it may be here to stay
item.description: Rising commodity prices squeezed HUL’s margins to multi-quarter lows in Q2, dampening investor sentiment despite revenue growth hitting a 14-quarter high.

item.title: Stockbrokers to seek Sebi clarity on peak margin math after EPI relief
item.description: On 22 October, Sebi eased margin requirements for trades made using proceeds from shares sold through the early pay-in mechanism. EPI allows investors to transfer shares to the clearing corporation before the usual settlement deadline.&nbsp;

item.title: Oil and gas stocks to buy: ONGC vs Oil India shares - Kotak Securities raises FY27 forecast to $100; know preferred pick
item.description: Kotak raised its FY27 crude assumption to $100 per barrel amid supply risks and lifted earnings estimates for ONGC and Oil India. ONGC remains its preferred stock, with a 57% implied upside to its ₹360 fair value; Oil India’s ₹365 fair value implies about 20% downside.

item.title: Top stocks to buy for long term: Pankaj Pandey of ICICI Securities suggests Crompton Greaves, Kotak Bank, 3 others
item.description: Markets have fallen sharply, but ICICI Securities’ Pankaj Pandey sees earnings resilience—not a broken growth story—behind the volatility. He expects double-digit returns over the next year and names five stocks, including Crompton Greaves and Kotak Mahindra Bank.&nbsp;

item.title: Groww, Zerodha open US stock investing to Indians: What it means for retail investors | The risks and rewards explained
item.description: Indian investment platforms are expanding access to US stocks as retail investors seek diversification amid weak domestic markets, a falling rupee and limited local AI options. Groww has launched trading, while Zerodha is testing the service.&nbsp;

item.title: HUL vs Nestle India shares compared: Which FMCG stock to buy post Q2 results: Who wins on profit, revenue and dividend?
item.description: The September-quarter results present investors with contrasting strengths: Nestlé India led on profit and revenue growth, while HUL delivered nearly three times Nestlé’s consolidated profit. HUL’s 7% volume growth impressed analysts, though margin pressure remains.

item.title: Meesho's margins shine, but risks keep investors wary
item.description: Meesho narrowed its Q2 loss as operating leverage lifted margins, but elevated marketing costs, intensifying competition and pressure on value-conscious consumers could test its growth and profitability targets.

item.title: Hyundai Motor India shares gain 5% despite profit slump; Why brokerages remain bullish | Check target prices
item.description: Hyundai Motor India shares rose over 5% after it reported record Q2 FY27 sales and revenue, despite a 23.9% drop in net profit as costs climbed. Three brokerages maintained Buy ratings, while analysts said the stock’s technical outlook remained weak, with resistance near ₹2,020.

item.title: STT hikes backfire? Zerodha's Nithin Kamath says traders are moving to ‘riskier options trades’
item.description: Zerodha's Nithin Kamath warned that higher securities transaction taxes and other curbs on futures and options trading may have pushed traders toward riskier behaviour. On Zerodha, about 50% of individual futures traders and 40% of option sellers were profitable, compared with 10% of option buyers.

item.description: Jupiter Wagons shares opened at ₹186.24 on NSE today, as compared to previous close of ₹181.05 on Wednesday.

item.title: Hero Motors shares: 3 back-to-back upper circuits! Stock jumps 46% from IPO issue price - Should you buy?
item.description: A three-session rally has lifted Hero Motors shares 46% above their IPO price, even as the stock remains down about 12% over the past month. Quarterly profit climbed 115.6% and revenue grew 24.9%, with margins improving.&nbsp;

item.title: Birlasoft shares surge 12% after Q2 results; Nuvama raises target price | technical experts flag key levels to watch
item.description: Birlasoft shares rose over 12% after Q2 FY27 net profit increased 37.5% year-on-year to ₹160 crore and revenue grew 6.6%. The company recommended a ₹3 interim dividend, while operating margins narrowed and Nuvama retained its Hold rating despite raising its target price to ₹300.

item.title: United Breweries shares: Up yesterday, down today - Why is the stock volatile? What lies ahead for it? Expert view
item.description: United Breweries shares fell nearly 3% after gains as investors booked profits despite strong Q2FY27 results. Profit surged 191% year-on-year and revenue rose 23.7% while analysts see longer-term potential from volume growth and premiumisation.&nbsp;
